title: OFARM ComplianceClaim v0.1 (candidate)
$comment: NEW_CANDIDATE implementation-profile contract. Durable carrier for the structured compliance claim captured verbatim with a COMPLIANCE_ASSERTION commit, so a later review act re-evaluates exactly what was claimed (Constitution RC2.1 sections 10-11 governance/compliance posture). Candidate per Constitution 6.16; not a promoted machine contract. Replaces the M1-interim serialization of the claim into SemanticEventEnvelope.notes (steward review of PR #4, finding 3). Linked from its semantic event by a COMPLIANCE_CLAIM edge; like ExecutionRecordPayload it is a carrier, not an authoritative promotion product, so it carries no PromotionTrace reachability requirement.

statement.description: What is being claimed, in the asserter's words.

governingRuleRefs.description: The governed rules/policies the claim is made against.

subjectScopeRef.description: The governed IdentityRecord the claim is about (gate-enforced: must resolve to a farm-contained IdentityRecord).

sourceEventRef.description: The SemanticEventEnvelope this claim was captured with.
